tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thub pa dgongs gsal gyi 'chad thabs rgyal sras bye ba phrag brgya'i chos sgo dang po phye ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣa ā nan+da dhā dza shrī bhā dra ye/ thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen gyi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i gsung rab thub pa dgongs gsal gyi/ /'chad thabs rgyal sras bye ba'i sgo 'di phye/ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan la/ don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir nges pa'i don du rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor gdon mi za zhing drang ba'i don du/ skye ba gzhan du sbyangs pa dang / /mkhas pa du ma bsten pa dang / /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ /shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob/ /ces dang / sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs can/ /sbrang bu min pas sbrang rtsi'i bcud ma myong / /gzhung lugs smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po min pas shes bya'i bcud ma myong / /zhes dang / gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med don smra ba/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes shākya'i sras po mchog /rdo rje'i rigs skyes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po las gzhan don mthun smra ba su/ /zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan zhing / mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa du ma gnang bas shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i spobs pa thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhag bzhin du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od zer gyis thub pa'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba/

sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'khor yug ri bo'i khongs las brgal ba de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di gang bshad par bya ba'i chos yin/ 'di nyid 'chad pa la yang mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / bstan bcos kyi lus dngos rnams su yod pa las/ de dag rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba ni 'di ltar yin te/ rgya gar skad du/ mu ni ma ta pra kā sha na ma sha satra/ bod skad du/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ zhes sogs dang sbrel la/ phar phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi phar phyin rdzogs pa'i/ lan dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes pa'i bar dag gsal snyan pa'i ngag gis brjod la/ 'o de rnams kyi sgo nas bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba 'di nyid kyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba/ bstan bcos lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yan gyi legs par bshad pa rnams bstan zin pa yin pas de ring gi chos thun de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod pa ni zhal ngo gdung brgyud rims pa bzhin che 'don mdzad pa'i nyi ma dang po'i chos thun gyi rim pa'i gnang lugs bstan zin nas/ nyi ma gnyis pa'i tshe// ༈ //'o nam mkha' dang ces sogs nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir/ mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lnga/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung gyur nas/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /mtshungs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga'am rtsa bdun gyi bar du mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung zhing / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku'i skye ba zam ma chad pa bzhes pas/

sku tshe 'di nyid du/ skye ba skye ba rnams su yang dang yang / /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs la sngon sbyangs shing / /tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis/ /gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi shes bya'i gnas thams cad 'bad pa chung ngu thugs su chud cing / lung rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par phye ste/ yang dag pa'i thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhes yongs su grags pa des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes kyang bya/ rgyal sras lam bzang zhes kyang bya/ tshogs chos chen mo zhes kyang grags par gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung 'di nyid ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos yin pa las/ de yang bstan bcos 'di'i lus dngos kyi brjod don phar phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi phar phyin yan chad kha sang gi gnas skabs su bstan zin nas/ de ring gi gnas skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas brtsams te de dag gi legs bshad rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang drug pa shes rab la gsum ste/ shes rab kyi mtshan nyid dang zhes sogs dang sbrel la/ gsum pa de la ye shes yod med dpyad pa la gsum las/ gzhan lugs/ rang lugs/ rtsod spong rnams rdzogs pa'i mjug gi rgyud gzhan grub pa las/ gnas gyur pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa ltar ro/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ 'o de rnams kyi sgo nas bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba 'di nyid kyi bstan bcos lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi shes rab kyi phar phyin nas brtsams te sa lam gyi 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi sku gsum ye shes sogs kyi rnam gzhag gi legs bshad rnams bstan zin pa yin pas de ring gi chos thun de la mdzad pa zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod pa ni nyi ma gnyis pa'i chos thun gyi rim pa rnams yin la/ nyi ma gsum pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang / zhes sogs nas/ gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lung bstan las/ kun dga' snying po sa skya lo tsā dang / /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa gtsang du 'byung / ces dang / sa skya lo tsā kun dga'i ming / /'phags pa'i ming can gnyis byung nas/ /bod 'bangs sems can bde la phan/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lnga bcur 'dzin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin/ ces gsungs/ de dag gi don slob dpon rin po ches sa chen la bstod pa las/ mgon khyod nges par rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /'jam pa'i dpal las gzhan du yod ma mchis/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ 'jam pa'i dpal yang mi yi gzugs 'dzin cing / /zhes dang / rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam mgon dbyer med pa'i/ /bla ma mchog dang dam pa khyod nyid la/ /khyad par 'ga' yang bdag gis yod ma shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / bsam pa dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs su mig gis mthong gyur nas/ /'phags pa'i yul du'ang gtam du de ltar grags/ /zhes gdul bya las dag pa rnams kyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su mthong ba'i chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid sngon gyi dus kyi lo tsā ba bai ro tsa nar yang sprul pa yin te/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i las can nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lung bstan las/ lo tsā dpa' gor bai ro tsa na khyod/ /tshe rabs skal bzang da dus tshigs la phan/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus kyi mthar thug pa/ /rim bzhin 'gro rnams 'dren dang bstan pa skyong / /khyad par dmu rgod 'dul mgo 'chol ba'i tshe/ /sa zhes bya ba shākya'i zhing khams su/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā paṇ+ḍi blo stobs can/ /sa skyong rgyal po'i mchod gnas byed pa ste/

/dmu rgod kha gnon 'gro la phan pa 'byung / /rgyud mangs rim bzhin de bzhin bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na de nyid snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar bya ba'i phyir bsam bzhin du byon pa ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen nyid yin te/ gsang ba'i lung bstan gab rgya can las/ da lta'i lo tsā bai ro tsa na khyod/ /nges don rnam snang gangs can mtsho zhes grags/ /longs sprul byang sems du mas 'gro ba 'dren/ /gsung gi sprul pa drang don bcu gsum gyis/ /mtha' ma 'khon gyi rigs la grags pa'i mtshan/ /bdud kyi nye mtshams sngags 'chang bstan pa skyong / /byang sems drag gtum ma nges snang tshul can/ /de dang 'brel tshad skye ba gsum nas grol/ /dri gnyis ltor song lag gis gang reg pa/ /ngan song skye sgo chod de nges tshig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / skyes chen de nyid chos rje sa paṇa du sku sprul pa'i tshe shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya bar sangs rgya bar lung bstan brnyes pa ni/ rje btsun mthu stobs nag po'i zhal snga nas/ /khyod ni nyi ma rgyal po'i bur gyur te/ /dri ma med dpal sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku'i snang brnyan ji snyed pa ston par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyi gsung rab thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba 'di nyid ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos yin pa las/ de yang bstan bcos 'di'i lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi shes rab kyi phar phyin nas brtsams te sa lam gyi 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi sku gsum ye shes sogs kyi rnam gzhag rnams bstan zin nas/

de ring gi gnas skabs su yon tan gyi chos phye ste bshad pa nas brtsam ste/ bstan bcos kyi mjug don sbyar byang bsngo ba zhar byung dang bcas pa'i bar gyi legs bshad rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang gsum pa yon tan gyi chos phye ste bshad pa la gnyis/ zhes sogs dang sbrel te/ mjug gi nga'i slob ma rnams kyi lung thob pa yin pas yi ge 'di la ltos la shod/ 'di bzhin nyams su longs/ zhes pa de yan gyis bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston mtha' dag spel zin pa yin pas/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la/ dge ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo bas rgyas btab la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyi mtha' rten rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba yi/ /'chad thabs rgyal sras bye ba'i sgo 'phar ni/ /dang por phye ba'i legs bshad ngo mtshar 'di/ /sa skya paṇa chen gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /dang 'dod yid ches dad pas rgyud gang ba'i/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros mig gsal bas/ /mkhas pa'i grangs su gtogs pa de yis sbyar/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag dang gdul bya yi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms te/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /dus 'di nyid du'ang lus brtas dbang po gsal/ /tshe dang bstan pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun 'di nyid/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa'i mthu ldan shog /tshul 'dir rang gi rigs las skyes pa'i bu/ /ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug ces bya ba'i/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa srid mtha'i bar/ /mi nyams rgyas par byed pa'i rtsa lag mchog /bslu med bla ma'i thugs rje las byung ba'i/

/rgyal sras gdung 'dzin de nyid gtsor gyur pa'i/ /ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur sa skya'i gdung gi rigs/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs la phan phyir brtsams/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan/ /sa skyar skyes pa'i nor bu lha sbyin zhes/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan khyad par ā k+ṣa ra'i/ /tshul la mkhas pa'i phul phyin gang des bgyis/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste/ gdan sa chen po 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig/ //dharme u dā ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarbā dā oṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ thub pa dgongs gsal gyi 'chad thabs rgyal sras bye ba phrag brgya'i chos sgo dang po phye ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
